reviews.t: Great hair cutter, easy to use.
reviews.x: My wife is a professional hair stylist. She cuts my hair every 2-3 weeks and relies heavily on using electric shears to do so.  This unit works very well. It can work plugged in, or with battery, which should give you about 40 minutes of time per charge.  The shears are sharp and do a great job of cutting through my thick hair. reviews.t: The Modern Way of Cutting and Styling
reviews.x: There are hair clipper manufacturers out there who think that they can impress potential buyers with the amount of parts in a clipper kit. My question is: Why would you want a hair clipper kit with 15, 20 or a million parts, when all you need is three parts? And another question: Why would you want blades that need oiling, when there are blades that work fine without any oil? reviews.x: When it comes to cutting hair, I learned to cut simple men's styles with a pair of [[ASIN:B00008BNZ4 Wahls]] by a pro.  On occasion, I will cut someone else's hair, but typically I cut my own.  My goatee consists of course hair, while everywhere else tends to be fine and straight.  Even though I have cut the hair on top of my head in the past, I primarily use my clippers to maintain my goatee and for manscaping. I am unlikely to ever return to Flowbee now because the QC5055 does the job much faster, it's less noisy and delivers a much better quality haircut. reviews.t: It works great. Who needs a barber?
reviews.x: This product works plugged in or for an adequate time on its rechargeable battery. the combs of different lengths lets you do your kids hair (or your spouse and relatives) without fear of botching it up. Start with the longer combs if you are concerned, and work down. Also, it gets really close if you want to simply do a military or crew cut. Norelco makes fine products, and this one does the job.

I bought this product 3 weeks back and it serves the purpose very well. I used it two times once with power and another time on battery. The battery lasted for about 40 mins and is good enough for a normal hair cut. The only complaint i have is that the attachments are on the cheaper side. They are delicate and need proper handling. But over all this is a great clipper.

reviews.t: Not enough power even plugged in
reviews.x: I'm so disappointed. I've only used this twice - on my son and my husband and it just binds up really easily. My son cries because it pinches his hair. I have been cutting hair for 10 years and have never had clippers this bad. Save your money!
Now I can do my haircut by myself. Everything is as expected. A little bit noisy and flimsy but I was warned by other reviewers.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the clippers as a money-saving alternative to paid haircuts, especially for families and self-cutters.
Many users find the clippers easy to use and effective for simple cuts, beards, and maintenance.
Several reviewers criticize the guide combs as flimsy or prone to bending.
Some users note limitations with thick or full hair and clogging of the cutting head.
Cordless operation is appreciated, though some mention reduced power or limited battery runtime when unplugged.
